title: A certified sixteen-prime-factor lower bound for Lehmer's totient problem - research revision

creators.name: Bhattacharjee, Deep
creators.affiliation: Formerly, Electro-Gravitational Space Propulsion Laboratory (EGSPL), Bhubaneswar, Odisha 751030, India

description:
The manuscript and sixteen-factor result are unchanged. This release archives the subsequent ten-statement Lean verification of the exact fixed-count reduction, actual totient-factorisation bridge, final-entry identities and deficit-one exclusion. Universal emptiness for all factor counts remains unproved.

Verification: Ten additional statements in lean/UniformFinite.lean passed a fresh local Lean 4.34.1 check with only standard axioms. They prove the specified reduction and identities, not all-k emptiness or every line of the Python DFS. The older finite-search and manuscript scopes remain as recorded.

Existing authorship and source credit are preserved. New material awaits author review. This is a research archive, not journal acceptance or a full requested closure.
notes: The package includes exact source archives, proof/attempt notes and scoped verification records. Component licences remain authoritative. No new full-conjecture closure is claimed.
